description: Paid: 0.005 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.005 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). Pay per call, solves one question: What blank two-way ledger template does FIM 2026 provide for an engagement? Raw parties, per-duty owed items with open/met/unmet status fields, and adjustment slots. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.

name: get_fim2026_ledger_template
title: FIM 2026: blank two-way inter-consideration ledger template (paid: 0.005 RLUSD / 0.005 USDC on Base / 0.005 RLUSD on Base via x402)
